title: Minecraft Cat
blurb: Minecraft cats meow like real cats, only smaller and slightly compressed, and they will not stop following you around once tamed with a raw fish. The ambient meow does practical work too: cats frighten creepers away, so hearing one near your base is genuinely reassuring rather than merely charming. Jungle ocelots came first and were famously impossible to tame, until a later update split them from cats and handed the cats to villagers. Play this into a call. Watch every cat owner present check their phone.
